extensionDescription.message: Marks YouTube videos you already watched. Community fork of Watchmarker. All data stays in your browser.

heroSubtitle.message: Choose when YouTube videos are marked as watched and how they look.

markingRulesHelp.message: Choose which signals can mark a video as watched. Changes are saved automatically.

conditionBrownavHelp.message: Mark it as watched as soon as its page opens in the browser.

conditionBrowhistTitle.message: When it appears in browser history

conditionBrowhistHelp.message: Mark it once Firefox records the video in your browsing history.

conditionYouprogHelp.message: Mark it after YouTube receives playback progress from the player.

conditionYoubadgeTitle.message: When YouTube shows its watched badge

conditionYoubadgeHelp.message: Use YouTube's own red watched indicator when it appears.

conditionYouhistTitle.message: When it appears in YouTube history

conditionYouhistHelp.message: Mark it once it shows up in your YouTube watch history.

appearanceHelp.message: Choose how watched videos look on YouTube.

visualizationFadeoutHelp.message: Dim thumbnails of videos you have already watched.

visualizationGrayoutHelp.message: Convert thumbnails of watched videos to grayscale.

visualizationShowbadgeHelp.message: Add a small label to videos you have already watched.

visualizationShowdateHelp.message: Add the date to the watched badge. Only visible when the badge is enabled.

visualizationHideprogressHelp.message: Hide YouTube's progress bar on videos you have already watched.

importHistoryHelp.message: Fill your timeline from sources you already have. Recent YouTube activity also syncs automatically every hour.

browserHistoryHelp.message: Scan Firefox history for YouTube videos. Usually only needed once.

youtubeHistoryHelp.message: Fetch videos from your YouTube account. Large histories can take a while.

searchHistoryHelp.message: Find a video in your local watched history.

yourDataHelp.message: Watched videos and settings stay in this browser. Export a backup before uninstalling or resetting.

deleteConfirm.message: Delete all watched history? This cannot be undone.

backupReadHelp.message: Choose a .database file exported by Watchmarker.
